reviews.title: Charged $99 for a subscription I don’t have
reviews.text: I woke up to a notification from my bank stating WeGLOW tried to use my card for a $99 annual purchase. The problem is I do not have a active subscription to WeGLOW. I’ve logged in to previous accounts I had and again there is no active subscription. I have screenshots of everything thankfully my card was locked however, I’m not sure why at 3 AM. reviews.title: Feel Strong and Beautiful
reviews.text: Whether you wanna try Barre, practice Pilates, need Gym structure, the instructors on this app really provide good support and guidance for all levels and interests. If you only have 10 minutes? No problem! This app gives you so much to choose from, along with meal plans and blog posts from experts and creators to give you a bit more info. 10/10 recommend.

reviews.title: Needs improvement
reviews.text: Not sure if it user error but I don’t like that timer stops my music everytime theres a break in between sets or next workout , it’s really frustrating having to press play 20x in a working puts me off. Will cancel subscription

reviews.title: Best Training App
reviews.text: Simply the best! Love love this app. I’m consistent with my workouts.

reviews.title: Love but New App Update
reviews.text: 1) I LOVE THIS APP 2) the workout programs the flow the way it’s organized literally everything about this app i love and im so grateful to have access to it! 3) I’m at the end of my third week and am am already seeing massive improvement and results - shout out to trainer Stef! One thing i noticed with the new app update, is that you can’t go “back” if the timer moves on to the next workout activity. Other issue i noticed is that with the new update, it pauses any music being played on the background of the phone. So  for example, if I’m playing music on my phone and am on the app & i “start the workout,” once the timer starts on the app, it automatically causes my music to pause. Say i press play to continue playing music in the background  , and im back in the app, it’ll continue playing music until the timer ends and moves on to the next workout, then my music stops again. Would love love love if this could be fixed! I think the examples of the movements are triggering the phone to think a video is being played where that wasn’t the case in the previous version of the app

reviews.title: Top tier
reviews.text: Great app with a variety of workout styles and guides to choose from depending on your goal, time or menstrual cycle. Love that you can swap out exercises. Easy to track your progress and improve your nutrition. A workout app made by women for women

reviews.title: Helpful but needs improvement
reviews.text:
Needs improvement. I love that this app makes planning workouts less chaotic and uncertain. The workouts are sensible and do make you work hard most of the time. I enjoy the challenges as well and the meal ideas are an added bonus. 
I’ve had the app for about a year now and i’ve noticed that there are technical errors throughout. A few times workouts have stopped playing and will not play about 25 minutes into a workout. It wasn’t a wifi issue because I connected to my cellular data and same issue would not resolve. Additionally, I’ve noticed workouts will be listed as an option for the week that say “coming soon” and won’t play because the instructor or Weglow team failed to upload them. The customer support could use a lot of work. I feel ignored and like the team doesn’t care since I’ve messaged numerous times for assistance and have been blatantly left on seen. For the price I paid on this app I’d expect more effort to address my questions or concerns. Not sure if i’ll renew my annual subscription due to this.

reviews.title: PLEASE Disable Flashing
reviews.text: I want to start using this app but I really don’t like the fact that you can’t view a workout without the “Start workout” button slashing at me. My ADHD cannot handle that. Please please let me know when this UI figure is removed so I can start the year subscription.

reviews.title: Very clumsy app
reviews.text: The app advertised a free week with an annual subscription but it just charged me for the year. There are a lot of supersets and it doesn’t let you skip workouts and come back. It also doesn’t let your music play while in the app. I reached out to support but no one responded. Gym Shark is free and is superior. I was very disappointed. Wish I could cancel and get my money back.

reviews.title: Great App
reviews.text: Honestly one of the best work out apps. I began to get tired of creating my own resistance training routines, and was also starting to look into Pilates. I found Alex and Stephanie on Instagram. This app (mainly the guides) are great for people who want a well rounded mix of resistance training and Pilates. Pilates is not for the weak like I originally thought….at least not with Stephanie.

reviews.title: changed my life
reviews.text: I’ve been a WeGlow member for 3-4 years and it’s been life changing. it’s my trainer, my gym, keeps track of everything and the  awards/milestone celebrations are so encouraging. I open this app even when I don’t have to work out. if I need guidance with food/nutrition, there’s that. it will even help align your workouts with your cycle. WeGlow is amazing! 12/10 recommend to everyone

reviews.title: I LOVE this app!!!
reviews.text: I love this app! Its completely FREE!!! It works well with me

reviews.title: Loved it but deceiving deal
reviews.text: I loved using the app I had cancelled my subscription and then saw a deal for being billed $8.33 dollars a month so I selected it and purchased it to only find out that I had been billed $100 for the yearly subscription. So keep an eye out for what you’re purchasing. Cause it said billed monthly, but it was a deal for the yearly plan.

reviews.title: Impossible to cancel
reviews.text: I canceled my subscription within the time frame and they are still trying to charge me for the quarterly price. I can’t do anything with my iPhone until I pay it and then I have to dispute it. It’s like being held hostage. Absolute nightmare. Do not recommend.

reviews.title: Pilates? I don’t think so
reviews.text:
I love Stef and really appreciate the variety of workouts she offers, but this app still needs a lot of work. The UI and the way the guides are organized make it extremely difficult to find the right video or program.

Another concern is the Pilates content. I’m not sure if Stef is certified, but the Pilates videos feel sloppy and don’t have the smooth flow you’d expect from proper instruction. I truly hope the team brings in a trained Pilates coach for future videos. I love the idea of hybrid training, but Stef’s Pilates videos are not there yet.

reviews.title: Could/needs to be better
reviews.text: Needs to have countdown with the beeps between for all workouts. For multiple workouts it just starts the 30 sec rep immediately with no warning. By time I realize it’s started I have to restart. Also need to be able to see your plans week days and adjust them.  I had to cancel and restart program becuase it wouldn’t allow me to switch days. Also some of the Pilates videos are soooo far away. I get you want to show you’re at a beach but it is compromising it. Also felt like she has zero transitions in her Pilates workouts. As an actual certified instructor  it seems choppy and sort of just made up on spot. Also you need to be able to back out during a rest or whenever in a workout and see how much is left or what’s up next. When I try to look back at workout it just asks me to quit. I like the evolve you app better

reviews.title: Charge
reviews.text: They charge me 99.99 and the promotion states 3 days free.

reviews.title: Wish yoga sessions were better
reviews.text: Have tried several of the yoga classes as I was hoping to swap from my dedicated yoga app to weglow but I cannot understand why all of the classes have such fast flows between poses. The yoga section is just Pilates part 2, none of the good decent paced yoga that can actually be calming AND challenging. I’ve been doing yoga for 6 years and have never seen anyone else practice yoga like it’s a cardio exercise. Disappointing.

reviews.title: Love but need update!
reviews.text: I use this app to sprinkle workouts into my week between in person classes & running. I like the versatility of both at home & gym workouts w varying lengths of time. My one request would be to have an “All Workouts Button” and be able to filter to from newest to oldest. I find the guides/body categories annoying and overwhelming. I’m more of a click and go girl and would love to just be able to see all the workouts and pick the newest ones. When I saw they added a new search feature it got my hopes up but there’s still no “new” filter. Please please please

reviews.title: Love it but…
reviews.text: Love this app, have been using it for two years now… that being said the app needs bug fixes, the challenge I've been using has stopped working for some reason, very bummed out it was my favorite and to be quite honest the other challenges aren't up to par in difficulty and efficiency

reviews.title: Good programming/terrible app design
reviews.text: Decent programming. Terrible app design. You cannot use Spotify seamlessly because the timer for the videos will turn it off. I found myself constantly toggling between the app and Spotify to put music on. There's no queuing for the movements. Video demo only. The app needs to be better streamlined, a few verbal cues during the movement to ensure the user is doing the movement correctly, and allow you to play music while you work out. It fails on the bare minimum necessity of a fitness app.

reviews.title: Not Free
reviews.text: Downloaded and signed all the way up just to find that to click on any of the pilates workouts they were literally ALL locked and you have to pay 😐

reviews.title: Bad
reviews.text: Terrible. Bc they keep sending me notifications like 30 times a day! Do not recommend

reviews.title: Customer service
reviews.text: I really enjoyed using this app but the pricing is false advertising. I had my first 3 days free and, as advertised, I should’ve gotten charged ~$8/month then charged $79.99 then $99 annually. That was not the case. I got hit with the $99 fee after the first 3 days. I contacted customer service and they told me there was nothing they can do since I purchased it through Apple and not through WeGlow directly, which isn’t mentioned anywhere when you first sign up. Thankfully Apple gave me a refund but be careful before you sign up. It’s too bad because I have been following Stef for so long and really enjoyed her workouts but this whole experience left a sour taste in mouth.

reviews.title: Watch app?
reviews.text:
I love the variety of workouts and guides; the ability to move workouts around, skip, pause guides. 

It would absolutely kill if there was a watch app as I prefer to leave my phone sitting to the side when I workout and manage my music and workout plan from my watch. 

I wish you could swipe down the timer within the workout, but that’s okay it wouldn’t completely close the timer. Sometimes I want to use my rest time to see what exercises are coming up.

reviews.title: Too much going on…
reviews.text: While I understand that all things need consistent development, the app is too different from what it was a few years ago. Most of the guides were straightforward and were designed for specificity within your goals. Recently there has been a push for different workout methods with different trainers, which is fine-  however, the original guides now take forever to download and have been pushed all the way to the backend of the app. This is a bummer because most of the original guides did not include pre-recorded workouts. Pre- Recorded workouts don’t work best in my opinion because it is run- on longform content.

reviews.title: AMAZING
reviews.text: I absolutely love this app, it has so much content and different features to fit into your life everyday. Even when you don’t feel like working out on your cycle it has a section of classes or exercises perfect for that time of the month and each phase of your cycles. They put a lot of work into this app and it shows! It is worth every penny. I’ve used it everyday since I’ve download it.

reviews.title: Disappointed
reviews.text: I am disappointed with the app. You don’t have the option to play music while using the app which is a huge fail. The workouts also go extremely fast & I take F45 classes and even the app is faster than those classes.

reviews.title: Good workout app for women
reviews.text:
I like the app! I just completed my first workout, and it was great. I love the workout interface, and I really appreciate that it’s specifically tailored to women.

To access the workouts, you’ll need a subscription, but they offer at least a 3-day free trial so you can decide whether or not to continue with the paid version. I came from Apple Fitness, and even though it’s a great app and more affordable, this one offers recipes, a personalized workout plan based on your specific needs, and customization options.

It also includes helpful articles on fitness and nutrition, along with recommendations. One standout feature is that it offers workouts tailored to the different phases of the menstrual cycle.

One thing I didn’t like—and this could be a good improvement—is the lack of music integration. It would be nice if it could sync with Apple Music, Spotify, SoundCloud, etc., like the Nike Training Club app. Right now, the workouts have no background music; the only sound you hear is a chime when there are three seconds left in an exercise.

Overall, considering everything the app offers, the price isn’t bad. Still, I believe a 3-day trial isn’t enough. A 7-day trial would be better so users can try a full week of workouts and gain more insight before committing.

reviews.title: Lots of Options!
reviews.text: I love that on WeGlow I can do a little bit of everything or a whole lot of one thing— and anything in between! I love to do challenges on this app when I am getting bored of going to the gym or doing Classpass classes. Or a last minute yoga session on the app when I’ve been having a stressful week. I’ve also done some of the recipes and they turned out yummy!! Lastly, I’ve enjoyed the informational blogs the app has—lots of great health tips🥰

reviews.title: Review
reviews.text: I have been using WeGlow for the past year and a half. Ever since I made the decision to be consistent - the app is what keeps me on track. I love the guides! Thankful for this app.

reviews.title: fix the timer
reviews.text: this app used to have a working timer, where it made sounds at the 3, 2, 1 mark and a different sound at zero. a couple updates ago, it began only making the sound at the zero mark. the countdown sounds were really helpful for mentally preparing myself for the next move. PLEASE bring them back!!!!!

reviews.title: Love this App!
reviews.text:
I have used this app many times and love the programs I’ve completed through it!
I do wish it was easier to skip through the timer sections cause I don’t always track the time via the app but can’t move to the next workout until it’s completed! I also wish I could adjust the workout once it’s started if a movement/machine isn’t available. But my favorite part is the meals! There are SO many. I feel like a lot of apps say that have meal plans and ideas but never to the amount that this one does! I love that there’s even fun drinks! It’s so fun and definitely unique to this app:-)

reviews.title: Unacceptable.
reviews.text: I get this app hoping for ONE free workout. Oh never mind, there are none. There aren’t even free recipes. And it’s a subscription. Completely a waste of my time.

reviews.title: Wish I could
reviews.text: I wanted to like this app but the lack of POC is a huge red flag for me. We exercise too.

reviews.title: Milking money
reviews.text:
Updated review, you don’t have access to everything EVEN IF YOU PAY THE $100 for the full year. There are 8 week premium workouts for purchase for $19.99. 
Totally not worth paying $100 then pay on top of that for more guides and workout outs. Won’t be renew or recommending anymore.

reviews.title: Love it so far!
reviews.text: I love this app so far!! It has everything you need. I have used other fitness apps (Alive, FORM, etc.) and this is becoming a favorite! My only note is that the most user friendly just yet. My music stops when the timer gives the 5-4-3-2-1 which can be annoying when working out. I also find the way to put in what weights you are lifting to be tedious. I had to click an up arrow until I got into the 50s when I wish it was something I could input on my own. Besides those 2 small things, I love it!
